Locked overlay parse_results.py. Means use successful requests only. output_tokens_per_s is the decode rate, (output tokens - 1) / (end-to-end - TTFT); output tokens are the server's usage.completion_tokens, else the streamed text-chunk count. RadixAttention hit rate = total cached prompt tokens / total prompt tokens over successful requests (usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens, returned with --enable-cache-report); prompts share a common first half by design, so about 50% is expected once warm. completed_request_rate_pct = successful / attempted requests. Unmeasured values read na (reason): no cached counts (smoke server), no streaming (TTFT and decode rate), request failed
